name: Summarize conversations and meeting interactions
description: Users requested summaries of dynamic interactions, such as meetings, live conversations, or multi-turn dialogues, often providing transcripts or notes to synthesize into concise reports. The requests frequently emphasized extracting specific decisions, action items, or users' intents rather than just generalizing static documents.
